parsed.post: Discarding the recent experiment (0.904915) as it performed worse than my best (0.895109). The experiment seems to have overshot or destabilized. I'm reverting to my best DEPTH=6, WD=0.1 config. Next, I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.08 to stabilize the depth 6 model with a smaller batch size.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate to 0.08 to stabilize the high-capacity DEPTH=6 model after the previous 0.1 LR attempt regressed.
